get.description: Retrieves the forwarding profile using profile ID.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the forwarding profile.

put.description: Updates the forwarding profile using profile ID.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the forwarding profile.

delete.description: Deletes the forwarding profile using profile ID.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the forwarding profile.

patch.description: Updates a specific forwarding profile using profile ID.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the forwarding profile.

get.description: Retrieves a list of forwarding profiles with optional keyword filtering and pagination support.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword to filter forwarding profiles by name or other attributes.

schema.description: Response object containing an array of forwarding profiles and pagination metadata.

post.description: Creates a new forwarding profile with specified web forwarding configuration.

schema.description: Response object containing the newly created forwarding profile details.

PublicWebForwardingProfileContract.title: PublicWebForwardingProfileContract
PublicWebForwardingProfileContract.description: Specifies the policies to define how Zscaler Client Connector treats traffic from user systems in the Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Private Access (ZPA) services.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the forwarding profile is active.

name.description: Specifies the name of the forwarding profile.

conditionType.description: Specifies the condition to match the forwarding profile with traffic.

dnsServers.description: The DNS servers where your corporate network sends DNS requests.

dnsSearchDomains.description: The search domains are configured as the primary domains for the network adapter used for connecting to Zscaler.

enableLwfDriver.description: Indicates if the option to install and use the WFP-based Zscaler driver for Flow Logging, Block Domain Profile Detection, Block All Inbound Traffic, Process-Based Application Bypass, Digital Experience (ZDX) Autosense Probes, and Location Policy Override is enabled.

resolvedIpsForHostname.description: The IP addresses that the hostname resolves to.

trustedSubnets.description: The subnet of the trusted network.

trustedGateways.description: The IP address of the default gateway.

trustedDhcpServers.description: The DHCP server of the trusted network.

trustedEgressIps.description: The egress IP address of the network.

enablePredefinedTrustedNetworks.description: Enables the use of predefined trusted networks.

enableAllPredefinedTrustedNetworks.description: Enables all predefined trusted networks for this profile.

trustedNetworks.description: Specifies the list of trusted networks.

forwardingProfileActions.description: Specifies the list of forwarding profile actions for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) traffic.

forwardingProfileZpaActions.description: Specifies the forwarding profile Private Access (ZPA) actions.

enableAllDefaultAdaptersForTrustedNetwor.description: Enables all default adapters for trusted network detection.

enableSplitVpnTrustedNetwork.description: Enables Split VPN mode for trusted network traffic.

enableSkipTrustedCriteriaMatch.description: Enables skipping of trusted network criteria matching.

unifiedTunnels.description: Specifies the list of unified tunnel configurations.

PublicForwardingProfileActionContractv2.description: Forwarding profile action configuration with comprehensive network, transport, and proxy settings.

networkType.description: Specifies the type of network for forwarding.

actionType.description: Defines the action to be taken for traffic matching this profile.

packetTunnelVersion.description: Version of the packet tunnel protocol to use.

primaryTransport.description: The primary transport protocol to be used.

dtlsTimeout.description: Timeout value in seconds for DTLS connections.

udpTimeout.description: Timeout value in seconds for UDP connections.

tlsTimeout.description: Timeout value in seconds for TLS connections.

mtuForZadapter.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) size in bytes for the Zscaler adapter.

enableBlockingUnreachableDomainsTraffic.description: Enables blocking of traffic to unreachable domains.

enableTlsFallback.description: Enables fallback to TLS when primary transport fails.

tunnel2FallbackType.description: Specifies the fallback behavior for Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0.

enableSendAllDnsToTrustedServer.description: Enables sending all DNS queries to the trusted DNS server.

v4FailCloseTrustedDnsServer.description: IPv4 address of the trusted DNS server for fail-close scenarios.

v6FailCloseTrustedDnsServer.description: IPv6 address of the trusted DNS server for fail-close scenarios.

enableRedirectWebTraffic.description: Enables redirection of web traffic through the tunnel.

enableDropIpv6IncludeTrafficInT2.description: Enables dropping of IPv6 traffic included in Z-Tunnel 2.0.

enableUseTunnel2ForProxiedWebTraffic.description: Enables using Z-Tunnel 2.0 for proxied web traffic.

enableUseTunnel2ForUnencryptedWebTraffic.description: Enables using Z-Tunnel 2.0 for unencrypted web traffic.

enablePathMtuDiscovery.description: Enables Path MTU Discovery for optimal packet sizing.

enableLatencyBasedZenEnablement.description: Enables latency-based Public Service Edge selection.

zenProbeInterval.description: Interval in seconds between latency probes to Public Service Edges.

zenProbeSampleSize.description: Number of samples to collect for latency-based Public Service Edge probing.

zenThresholdLimit.description: Threshold limit in milliseconds for latency-based Zen selection.

enableDropIpv6TrafficInIpv6Network.description: Enables dropping of IPv6 traffic when on an IPv6 network.

enableOptimiseForUnstableConnections.description: Enables optimization for unstable network connections.

enableUseZiaBccOnTunnel2Failures.description: Enables use of Internet & SaaS (ZIA) BCC (Backup Control Channel) on Z-Tunnel 2.0 failures.

proxyAction.description:
Defines system proxy settings for user devices:

  • Enforce
  • Apply On-Trusted Network Type change
  • Never

enableAutoDetect.description: Indicates whether Auto Detect is enabled.

enableProxyServer.description: Indicates whether a proxy server is enabled.

enableBypassProxyForPrivateIp.description: Whether proxy bypass is enabled for private IP addresses.

enablePerformingGpUpdate.description: Whether performing a Group Policy (GP) update is enabled.

pacDataPath.description: Specifies the registry path and name.

primaryTransport.description: Specifies the primary transport for Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0.

dtlsTimeout.description: Specifies the time in seconds the Zscaler Client Connector waits before falling back to another transport mechanism.

tlsTimeout.description: Specifies the time, in seconds, that Zscaler Client Connector waits before falling back to another transport mechanism.

mtuForZadapter.description: Specifies the maximum transmission unit (MTU) for the Zscaler adapter.

enableSendTrustedNetworkResultToZpa.description: Indicates whether to send the trusted network detection results to Private Access (ZPA).

enableLatencyBasedServerEnablement.description: Enables latency-based server selection for optimal performance.

lbsProbeInterval.description: Specifies the time interval (in seconds) in which an IP address connects with a server. The default is 60 seconds.

lbsProbeSampleSize.description: Specifies the number of retries required to establish a connection before a failover. The default is 5 times.

lbsThresholdLimit.description: Specifies the change in latency of the primary and secondary Public Service Edges for Private Access.

primaryTransport.description: Indicates whether Allow TLS Fallback is enabled.

mtuForZadapter.description: Specifies the maximum transmission unit (MTU) for the Zscaler adapter.

  • Block all traffic
